character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist in every scene: metallic silver hair in two sleek high ponytails, bright electric-blue eyes, with a recognizable consistent face and adult proportions. They are a Y2K-era dance-game champion and digital fashion designer. Their fixed signature outfit is a chrome-silver cropped jacket over a vivid blue top, low-rise utility trousers, and platform sneakers. Their defining personal object is a translucent flip phone with a custom holographic charm. Keep face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, body proportions, costume silhouette, and personal object unchanged throughout the entire music video.
consistency_rules: Use this one fixed protagonist identity throughout the theme's entire video.
Preserve the same facial features, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature outfit, silhouette, colors, and defining personal object consistent in every scene.
Do not replace the lead or add another protagonist unless the lyrics explicitly require one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in chrome-filled futuristic room, translucent gadget shelf, glossy blue sky with bubbles; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with chrome silver, bubble blue, candy pink, lime; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by close-up pan across chrome shapes, slow orbit around a translucent device, wide shot of a glossy futuristic room; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

available_styles: slow orbit around a translucent device
wide shot of a glossy futuristic room
camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
